Rabby public response subset captured 2026-10-22 using a public example address.
Sources: api.rabby.io/v1/chain/list, /v1/user/token_list (Ethereum),
/v1/user/cache_token_list (Arbitrum sample), and /v1/user/token (USDT quote).
Only fields used by the parser are retained; decimal quotes are preserved as strings.
No wallet credentials or private data are present.
